# EGO POWER+ LB8803-2 — 880 CFM Cordless Handheld Blower (Kit)

**Category:** Leaf Blower (Cordless Handheld)

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Model / variant | LB8803-2 (kit); LB8800 is the tool-only variant |
| Battery platform | EGO POWER+ 56V ARC Lithium™ (compatible with all EGO 56V batteries) |
| Included batteries | 2 × 56V 4.0Ah ARC Lithium™ (BA2242T) |
| Included charger | 320W (CH3200) |
| Motor | High-efficiency brushless; turbine fan design |
| Max airflow | Up to 880 CFM (turbo mode, tapered nozzle) |
| Max air speed | Up to 200 MPH (turbo mode, tapered nozzle) |
| Variable-speed range | 270–700 CFM via trigger, with cruise lock |
| Display | Digital readout of blower speed, battery charge, and cruise-lock status |
| Body | Carbon fiber |
| Grip | Primary handle plus secondary grip zones for two-handed use |
| Weather resistance | IPX4 |
| Runtime | Up to 90 min combined with the two included 4.0Ah batteries |
| Included accessories | Tapered nozzle, spread nozzle, shoulder strap |
| Compatible accessories | Short tube attachment (AST2000), gutter cleaning kit (AGC1000) |
| Warranty | 5-year limited tool; 3-year limited battery/charger |
| Documentation | [Manual (PDF)](https://egopowerplus.com/mpattachment/file/download/id/4053/) · [Parts list (PDF)](https://egopowerplus.com/mpattachment/file/download/id/4302/) |

## Notable Features

- Highest-output handheld blower in EGO's lineup: 880 CFM / 200 MPH in turbo, marketed as outperforming premium gas blowers.
- Digital display shows speed, battery level, and cruise-lock state in real time.
- Variable-speed trigger with cruise lock covers 270–700 CFM for everyday work; turbo is a separate boost for wet leaves, mud, rocks, or snow.
- Carbon fiber housing keeps weight down despite the output.
- Ships with two 4.0Ah batteries, so one can charge while the other runs — roughly 90 minutes of total runtime.
- Tapered and spread nozzles included; gutter and short-tube attachments available.
- IPX4 weather-resistant construction.
- Manufacturer page currently shows "Coming Soon" with no published price; retailers have listed the kit around $370.
